basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old college student studying engineering in the D.C. area. I recently got into following the Washington Wizards more closely, as I've been trying to get into basketball as a hobby. When I'm not buried in textbooks, I enjoy canoe camping and discovering quirky online communities. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends. Currently single, but enjoying the freedom college life brings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to basketball and the NBA, trying to learn more by watching games and reading up on team histories. Most of my knowledge comes from YouTube videos and reading posts on basketball forums. My educational background is in engineering, so I have a solid grasp of technical concepts and problem-solving.
